tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug tshul legs par bshad pa'i yi ge bod yul 'gro kun bsgrod pa'i chos sgo phyogs brgyar ring du phye ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru tsakra nā tha bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog la rab btud nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi gsung rab la/ /'jug tshul chos sgo phyogs brgyar bskal ba'i bar/ /ring du phye ba'i legs bshad 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug pa'i tshul la/ thog mar sgo dang 'dra ba'am sgo'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po bzhi la bslabs nas/ bka' bab chen po bzhi la gnas te/ sdom rig gnyis kyis byi dor byas nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la brtson par byed pa ni lam la 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /de'i dang po bstan bcos chen po bzhi ni/ rtsa ba rje rtse mos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i byis pa 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba yi ge'i ring thung dang sgra'i sdeb sbyor sogs gtso bor ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos de nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su rtse mo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba dang por ston pa'i byon tshul/ de'i bstan pa byung tshul/ de la 'jug pa'i tshul la sogs pa ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos de la bslab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su yang rtse mo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba mdo rgyud mtha' dag gi gnas lugs so sor shes par byed pa'i bstan bcos rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa la bslab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i mkhas pa 'jug sgo zhes bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam gzhag ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po de la bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar bslabs nas/ de'i rjes su bka' bab chen po bzhi la gnas par bya ba ni/

dpal sa skya pa chen po nyid la 'brog mi lo tsā ba nas lam 'bras la sogs lam skor dgu kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams ngag gi bka' babs pa dang / mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa nas bde mchog lū nag dril gsum dang / gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum la sogs pa'i gdams ngag dang / mgon po'i skor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig babs pa dang / dgun blon lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas brgyud pa/ bla ma yon tan tshul khrims nas/ yo ga che chung dang chos skyong gi skor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig babs pa dang / ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i bya spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bab pa rnams yin no/ /de la 'dir de rnams kyi dang po 'brog mi chen po nas babs pa'i kyai rdo rje'i lam rim gtso bor gyur pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i lam gyi rim pa 'di gtan la 'bebs pa la/ 'di mdo rgyud kyi theg pa gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba dang / ngos zin pa de la lam srol ci tsam byung dpyad pa dang / srol de dag gi nang nas rmad du byung ba'i lam srol ngos bzung ba dang / ngos zin pa'i lam de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnad kyi gsal byed las/ bde gshegs gsung las theg chen gsang sngags rgyud/ /rgyud sde bzhi la bla ma gnyis med mchog /ces gsungs/ de la bde gshegs gsung zhes pas lam srol 'di nyid bstan pa la phyi nang gnyis su yod pa las/ nang gi khongs su gtogs par bstan/ theg chen zhes pas theg pa che chung gnyis las chen por bstan/ gsang sngags rgyud ces pas chen po la'ang rgyu 'bras gnyis su yod pa las 'bras bu sngags kyi theg par bstan/ rgyud sde bzhi las bla ma zhes pas 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa/ de la yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi yod pa las/

rnal 'byor bla ma'i khongs su gtogs par bstan/ gnyis med mchog ces pas/ bla med la yang pha ma gnyis med dang gsum du yod pa las/ gnyis med kyi rgyud kyai rdo rje'o/ /de lta bu'i lam srol las/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud du yod/ bod du du 'gyur/ skabs su babs pa ngos ji ltar 'dzin snyam na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag bdun pa/ bsdus pa 'bum phrag lnga pa/ rgyud phyi ma phyag chen thig le/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po thig le/ thun mong min pa'i bshad rgyud ye shes thig le/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud dpal saṃ bhu ṭi 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa/ snying po'i rgyud sgrub pa nges bstan thig le/ 'bras bu'i rgyud de kho na nyid sgrol ma thig le/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa nas phyung ba brtag pa gnyis pa dang / rdo rje gur/ sam̐ bu ṭi 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa nas phyung ba/ dpal kha sbyor gyi rgyud dang / rdo rje a ra li/ rnyog pa med pa'i a ra li/ rigs kyi a ra li ste rgyud bcu bzhi tsam gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas bod du rgyud rgyas pa gur brtag sam gsum/ 'bring thig le skor lnga/ bsdus pa a ra li skor gsum rnams 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi nang nas 'dir skabs su babs pa ni gtso bor gur brtag sam̐ gsum mo/ /gnyis pa lam srol ji tsam byung dpyad pa la/ spyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lam gyi srol bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung mod kyang / bod du 'gyur ba la gzhung 'grel bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po drug gi bka' rim gyi lam rim yongs su rdzogs pa drug dang / man ngag brgyud pa las 'byung ba gnyis te brgyad tsam byung / de rnams kyi dang po drug ni ḍom+bhi pa'i skor/ mtsho skyes kyi skor/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i skor/ shan+ti pa'i skor/ snyan grags bzang po'i skor/

gnyis med rdo rje'am a wa dhu ti pa'i skor rnams so/ /dang po la lus dang yan lag tu gyur pa'i yig cha'i tshogs ci tsam yod snyam na/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa ku mu ti/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung / lha dgu'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ yum lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim gtum mo'i 'grel chung / 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rnams la mi thub zla ba'i gzhung bdun zer ro/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba/ dran pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od/ rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes grub/ yan lag tu gyur pa'i gzhung ni/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ phyag mtshan gyi dag pa/ tshogs 'khor dang tshogs 'khor gyi bslab bya 'du ba sgrag pa/ sngags don gyi gzhung gnyis/ sbyin sreg dang man ngag gi ro sreg ste gzhung nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/ gnyis pa mtsho skyes skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa pad+ma can/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas gling ma/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ bstod pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa yod/ gsum pa nag po pa'i skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba rin chen sbyor ba'i phreng ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhung 'grel sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ phyag bcu drug pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ yum gyi sgrub thabs gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gcig rab gnas tshul bzang mo/ tshogs 'khor dang bstod pa/ sbyin sreg dang ro sreg la sogs pa yod do/ /'di yan la gtso che'i chos sum cu dgu zer ro/ /bka' srol 'di gsum gyi dbang bka' dang bshad bka' sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa la tshang la ma nor ba deng sang gi bar bzhugs pa yin gsungs so/ /bzhi pa shan+ti pa'i skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga he ru ka 'byung ba/ sgrub thabs 'khrul sbyong rtsa 'grel gnyis/ yum gyi sgrub thabs gcig rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba la sogs pa la yang dag par sbyor ba rtsa 'grel gnyis la sogs pa yod do/ /'di'i dbang bka' sogs dpal sa skya pa la mi bzhugs gsungs/ lnga pa snyan grags bzang po'i skor la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa na ro 'grel chen du grags pa yod gsungs/ 'di la lam srol yongs su ma rdzogs sam snyam na rdzogs te/ 'grel pa 'di'i nang na bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa gzhung nag 'byams kyi tshul du bzhugs pa yin no gsungs/ kha cig 'grel pa 'di jo bo na ro ta pas mdzad par bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'grel pa 'di'i mjug tu/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ /dge slong snyan grags bzang pos sbyar/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / 'di gnyis dus kyang mi mtshungs te/ dge slong 'di'i zhabs ni dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos zin la/ lo tsā ba de ni chos rje sa paṇa dang dus mnyam pas so gsungs/ bka' srol 'di'i bshad bka' sogs sa skya pa la bzhugs gsungs so/ /drug pa a wa dhu ti pa'i skor la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi rab byed/ sgrub thabs rnam par dag pa'i gter/ yum gyi sgrub thabs gcig rdzogs rim lta ba ngan sel rtsa 'grel gnyis la sogs pa a ma na se'i gzhung nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /bka' srol 'di'i dbang bka' sogs bod na deng sang mi bzhugs gsungs/ gzhan yang brtag pa gnyis pa la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i stod 'grel/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i smad 'grel/ pad+ma'i myu gu can gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag po pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ ka ma dhe nus mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bha wa bha ṭas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ ṭam̐ ka da shas mdzad pa'i de'i 'grel bshad rnams bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang 'brog mi'i skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad du grags pa ni/

gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa/ rtsa ba'i mngon rtogs che chung gnyis/ dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ brda'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje glu 'grel pa che chung rnams yin no/ /gzhan yang byang chub snying pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa gzhung phran bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig 'gyur kyang / lam yongs su rdzogs pa ni gong du smos pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po drug po de tsam du zad do/ /man ngag brgyud pa la brten pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ jo bo na ro ta pa la mar pa lho brag pas/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mahā ma ya rnams zhus nas/ mar pa'i ka chen bzhir grags pa dang / de dag gi nang gses kyi dkyil 'khor bdun la sogs pa gsan nas slar bod du byon te mes ston chen po sogs la gnang / mes ston gyis 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar la gnang / des sa skya pa chen po la gnang ste/ de'i brgyud pa ni rje sa chen nyid nas chad nas med gsungs/ yang mar pa lho brag pa nyid kyis gzhung gi rngog ston chos kyi rdo rje la gnang ba'i brgyud pa deng sang gi bar du ma chad par bzhugs pa yin zhing / de'i phyogs kyi yig cha yang rngog chos rdor gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rin po che'i rgyan zhes bya ba dang / de'i slob mas mdzad pa'i rin po che'i rgyan 'dra zhes bya ba/ mes ston chen pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ ram sding ma ba sangs rgyas 'byung gnas rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ lcam ston blo gros grags kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ rngog thogs med grags kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ ru mtshams kyi skyob pa ag skyo bh+ya zhes bya bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sogs yod/ gzhan yang smin byed dbang gi cho ga sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ rdzogs rim sde 'pho'i gdams ngag sogs yig cha'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod cing / lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' srol yin zhes gsungs so/

/gzhan yang kye rdo rje dpyal lugs su grags pa yod de/ 'dis bla ma pham thing pa sku mched la gsan pa yin pas/ jo bo na ro ta pa'i lugs su 'dug pas/ brgyud pa'i ngos nas mar pa las logs su ma smos so/ /man ngag brgyud pa gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas shar phyogs kyi nag po pa la brgyud 'ongs pa 'di yin zhing / 'di'i phyogs kyi yig cha ji tsam byung ba la sogs pa 'og tu ston par byed do/ /gsum pa de rnams kyi nang nas rmad du byung ba'i lam srol ngos bzung ba ni/ bka' srol chen po brgyad kyi phyi mar gyur pa de'o/ /'o na bka' srol 'di nyid lam gzhan las rmad du byung ba'am khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gzhan las rgyud la brten tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags/ rgyud 'chad tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags/ bshad nas thon pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /dang po rgyud la brten tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags te/ gong gi lam srol 'ga' zhig rgyud la ma brten pas nyi tshe ba tsam du snang / 'ga' zhig brten kyang rtsa bshad gang rung las yongs su rdzogs pa la ma brten par snang mod/ 'di ni rtsa bshad gsum ka la brten pas so/ /gong gi rnams rgyud gsum ka la rdzogs par ma brten par rtsa bshad gang rung la brten pa ni brten mi dgos pas ma brten pa yin no snyam na/ de ni ma yin par rgyud gsum ka la brten dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ni rtsa ba'i rgyud du bskyed rdzogs mdor bstan pa las med pa de nyid kyi bskyed rim rgyas par rdo rje gur nas ston zhing / rdzogs rim rgyas par sam̐ bu ṭi nas ston pas na rgyud gsum ka la brten dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyud 'chad tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ 'ga' zhig rgyud sgrub thabs ltar 'chad pa/ 'ga' zhig sgrub thabs rgyud ltar 'chad pa sogs yod mod/ 'dir ni rgyud rgyud ltar 'chad pa yin no/

/de yang / gdams ngag drug dang rgyud gsum dag pa gsum/ /bdag nyid can gsum gsang bdun gnas pa bzhis/ /tshig dang don rtogs bshad thabs man ngag gi /gsal byed 'di ni gsang rgyud 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chad pas so/ /gsum pa bshad nas thon pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas khyad par 'phags te/ 'dir ni rgyud gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i mngon par rtogs pa gsum la phye ba'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga bcu nga bdun gyi rnam gzhag ston par byed pa rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di lta bu yod pas so/ /'di 'dra ba'i bstan bcos snga rabs pa rnams kyis kyang ma gsungs/ gsungs kyang thon par mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ spyi don bzhi pa ngos zin pa de nyid gtan la dbab pa'i tshul la bzhi ste/ gzhung tshogs sam grub mtha' spyi'i rnam gzhag shes par bya ba'i phyir thun mong gzhung gi bshad pa la 'jug pa/ nyams len dang nyams myong nges par bya ba'i phyir thun mong min pa man ngag gi rim pa la 'jug pa/ de dag la spros pa spyad cing log rtog bsal ba'i phyir sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa/ de dag gi dgongs pa gcig tu dril nas gsum dkrugs su sbyar ba'i lam rim gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po thun mong ba gzhung gi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ gzhung gi dkar chag las byung ba ltar/ dgos tshan bzhis bsdus pa'i bstan bcos nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rigs su gtogs pa'i gzhung gi tshogs rnams la thos bsam byed pa'o/ /de la dgos tshan bzhi ni/ rgyud spyi la dgos pa/ rgyud gsum so so la dgos pa/ gang zag spyi la dgos pa/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa dang bzhi'o/ /bstan bcos nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ rgyud gsum spyi la dgos pa'i gzhung bdun/ rgyud gsum so so la dgos pa'i gzhung drug gang zag spyi la dgos pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi/

sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa'i gzhung gcig rnams yin no/ /de'i dang po gzhung bdun ni/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam dag mngon rtogs dang / /stong thun gnyis kyi bsdus don bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa'i/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de'i dang po rgyud sde'i dum bu ni/ rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad de/ 'di la yang tshul bzhi ga'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i rgyud sde'i dum bu brgya lnga bcu byas pa gcig dang / mngon rtogs ljon shing kho na'i rtsa bar byas pa'i rgyud sde'i dum bu brgya dang bcu gsum tsam byas pa gcig ste gnyis snang gsungs/ rnam gzhag ni sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam dang / rje rtse mos mdzad pa'i spyi rnam chen mo gnyis yin no/ /mngon rtogs ni/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i rin po che'i ljon shing yin no/ /stong thun gnyis kyi don ni rje btsun chen pos mdzad do/ /bstod pa gnyis ni yab kyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka dang / yum gyi bstod pa dri ma med pa'i rgyan gnyis te rje btsun chen pos mdzad do/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel ni chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad do/ /rgyud gsum so so la dgos pa'i gzhung drug ni/ rgyud gsum so so'i rnam 'grel don bsdus bcas/ /gang la gang 'dod de dang de blang bya/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par bltas byas nas/ /rnam par phye bas rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de la rtsa rgyud kyi rnam 'grel sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel mngon rtogs/ rje rtse mos mdzad pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa rnam bshad dag ldan/ sa chen gyi bsdus don/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i bsdus don/ chos rje paṇa chen gyis kha bskangs pa dang bcas pa yod/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur la rje sa chen gyi don gyi chings/

zin bris kyi yig sna gnyis/ mchan bu/ rje btsun chen po'i 'grel pa gur rgyan/ sa dpyad rnams yod/ sam bu ṭi la rje sa chen gyi brtag pa phyi ma la yig sna gnyis yod/ rje rtse mo'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed/ sa dpyad/ thabs shes rab kyi zur bkol gyi yig sna dang gsum yod do/ /gang zag spyi la dgos pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi ni/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam gzhag sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blugs dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten sgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i las can nas/ /brtsams te gang zag kun gyis blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de'i dang po smin byed ni/ rje rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang gi chu bo chen mo/ ltung ba'i rnam gzhag ni rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / sgrub thabs bzhi ni/ yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa rtse mos mdzad pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ bsdus pa skad cig gi bskyed pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs rje btsun gyis mdzad pa rnams so/ /rab gnas ni rje btsun sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i bzang drug go /sbyin sreg kyang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg sku mched gnyis kas mdzad do/ /tshogs 'khor ni rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor 'bring po dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi rtsod spong gnyis so/ /rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag gi yig cha gcig yod pa de ni rje btsun gyis mdzad par grags te/ de ni rje btsun zhes pa'i ming la 'khrul pa yin gyi/ don rje btsun mar pas mdzad par snang gsungs/ rang lugs kyi rdor dril gyi rnam gzhag gnad kyi gsal byed na yod pa de blta'o/ /dgang blugs kyi rnam gzhag ni/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi nang du blta'o/ /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten sgrub pa ni/

rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i yig cha yod do/ /gzhan yang sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa'i gzhung gcig ni/ lus rgyan btung ba'i snod dang gzung bya'i rdzas/ /rol mo'i cho ga stan dang bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang ldan pa'i yi ge rje btsun gyis mdzad pa he ru ka'i chas drug ces bya ba'i gzhung yod do/ /don gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa man ngag gi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ man ngag gi dkar chag las 'byung ba ltar tshad ma bzhis bsdus pa'i gzhung drug cu tham pa la thos bsam byed pa ste/ de yang tshad ma bzhi ni/ bla ma tshad ma/ nyams myong tshad ma/ bstan bcos tshad ma/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung tshad ma dang bzhi yin la/ gzhung drug cu ni/ thog mar bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su/ bla ma rgya gar ba dang / bod kyi rnam thar gyi yi ge gnyis/ nyams myong tshad ma'i skabs su khrid kyi gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ 'phros 'gyur gyi yi ge bcu bdun/ lam zab 'bring gsum gyi yi ge gsum ste yi ge nyi shu rtsa dgu yod de/ de yang gzhung shing bzhi ni/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi bkri ba'i/ gdams ngag gi gnad drug gis bkri ba'i/ gdams ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing bzhi'o/ /rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga ni/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag gi gnad bdun/ phyi nang gi lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis rnams yin no/ /'phros gyur gyi yi ge bcu bdun gyi dang po/ gegs sel yi ge bzhi ni/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi gtong ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyi gsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams yin no/

/smin byed kyi skabs su gdan sogs kyi yi ge dbang gi chu bo chen mo/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten te bskur ba'i yi ge dbang gi man ngag gi gnad kyi yi ge lta ba'i skabs su 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ dam tshig gi skabs su bsrung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / bza' ba'i dam tshig tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs su yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ bsdus pa skad cig bskyed pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge gsang dbang gi skabs su yum gyi byin rlabs rnams yin no/ /lam zab 'bring gsum gyi yi ge gsum ni/ 'bring po rtsa ba med pa'i yi ge bsdus pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge ste gzhung nyi shu rtsa dgu 'di yan la yod do/ /bstan bcos tshad ma'i skabs su 'grel pa gnyag ma/ gsal byed nyer gnyis/ rdo rje tshig rkang gi bsdus don te gzhung nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /lung tshad ma'i skabs su/ lung sbyar chen po bzhi yod de/ bzhi ni lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba dang / lung 'di nyid mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang / lung mtha' dag dang / mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ mtha' dag dang zhib tu sbyar ba bzhi yin no/ /yi ge gcig ni dmar chung gi dkar chag yin no/ /gsum pa de dag la spros pa spyad pa'i phyir sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa ni rang mchan/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la 'phrin du zhu ba/ skyes bu dam pa la springs yig dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams la springs yig ste springs yig gsum dang / chag lo'i dris lan/ do gor ba'i dris lan/ nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan te dris lan gsum la thos bsam byed pa yin no/ /don bzhi pa de dag gsum dkrugs su sbyar ba'i lam ni/ spyir gong du smos pa'i lam rim gsum po re res kyang lung rigs man ngag gsum gsum gyi sgo nas lam yan lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa re re ston mod kyang /

gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na lam rim dang pos lung dang bcas te lam gyi khog phub/ lam rim gnyis pas man ngag dang bcas te lag len gyi rim pa bstan/ lam rim gsum pas rig pa dang bcas te lam gyi spros pa gcod par byed pas na lam gsum gcig tu bsre'o/ /de ltar bsres pas gang zag rim gyis pa bkri ba'i lam rgyas pa gcig dang / cig car ba bkri ba'i lam bsdus pa gcig gnyis thon pa yin no/ /dang po lam rgyas pa la khog sgrig gi yi ge bcu yod de/ gang zhe na/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ zhus lan gsal ba rnams kyis lam rgyas pa khog phub pa'i tshul gyis gtan la 'bebs/ dbang gi chu bo chen mo/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing / dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi bkri ba'i gzhung shing rnams kyis lam rgyas pa dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs/ 'bar srung thun mong min pa'i gdams ngag brda don gsal ba rtsa sngags bzhi bshad rnams kyis mtshon byed brda'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs/ sdom gsum rab dbyes lam rgyas pa sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag bsdus nas gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ gnyis pa la bsdus pa cig car ba'i lam la khog sgrig gi yi ge gdams ngag gi gnad drug gis bkri ba/ bcu gcig gis bkri ba/ lam 'bring po rtsa ba med pa/ bsdus pa bsgrub pa lung sbyin/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de ltar phye ba'i lam rim bsdus pa de dag kyang lam rgyas pa rnams su 'du zhing / rgyas pa de dag kyang gzhung gi lam rnams ljon shing du 'du/ man ngag gi rnams gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing du 'du/ spros pa gcod byed kyi yi ge rnams sdom gsum gyi rnam gzhag tu 'du gsungs/ de ltar 'du zhing gcig tu bsres pa'i tshul yang / ljon shing gi rgyu rgyud kyi gnas skabs kyi mngon rtogs bzhi/ thabs rgyud kyi skabs nas skyabs 'gro

gso sbyong / so thar bstan khrims bdun te mngon par rtogs pa bcu gsum gyis khog phub/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i skabs dang pos de dag gi spros pa bcad/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing ma dag pa'i snang ba'i skabs kyis nyams su blang / yang ljon shing gi dus nam skye med pa'i sems bskyed dang / lta ba'i mngon rtogs bzhi rnams kyis lta ba'i khog phub/ sdom gsum gyi skabs gnyis pas spros pa bcad/ gzhung shing thun mong ba'i nyams rnam snang gi skabs kyis nyams su blang / yang ljon shing gi rgyud sde bzhi'i skabs/ kye rdo rje'i smin byed dbang gi skabs kyi mngon par rtogs pa bdun/ grol byed lam gyi skabs kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig rnams kyis lam gyi khog phub/ sdom gsum gyi skabs gsum pas spros pa bcad/ gzhung gi thun mong min pa'i nyams snang dang / rgyud gsum gyi lam bsgom pa'i skabs rnams kyis nyams su blang / yang ljon shing gi 'bras bu'i skabs kyi mngon rtogs bcu bdun gyis khog phub/ sdom gsum gyi 'bras bu'i skabs la spros pa spyod byed rnams kyis spros pa bcad/ gzhung shing gi snang ba gsum gyi 'bras bu'i skabs dang / rgyud gsum gyi 'bras bu'i skabs rnams kyis nyams su blang ngo / /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug tshul legs par bshad pa'i yi ge bod yul 'gro kun bgrod pa'i chos sgo phyogs brgyar ring du phye ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di yang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa rgyal ba'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun/ rje de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma chos rje chos dpal bzang pos yi ger btab pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa 'di ni/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sngon byon pa'i sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dpon slob rnams la dang 'dod kyi dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i ngang nas/

phyin chad kyang skal bzang las 'phro can gyi skyes bu rnams lta grub rnam par dag pa'i lam la kun kyang rgyun chad med par 'khrid pa'i slad du bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas mgyogs par sbyar ba'o/ /'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /mthar thug gyur nas bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa rab rgyas shog /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas srid mthar bstan pa 'dzin pa sogs/ /lhag bsam rnam dag yid la re ba'i don/ /'di rnams srung mas 'bad med bsgrub gyur cig /deng nas bzung ste 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /'gro kun sa skya'i bzhed gzhung rjes 'jug tu/ /byed pa'i mthu stobs ldan par bdag gyur cig /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug tshul legs par bshad pa'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
